title: Spiral Matrix
prompt:
Return all elements of the matrix in spiral order (clockwise from the top-left).

**Example**: `[[1,2,3],[4,5,6],[7,8,9]]` → `[1,2,3,6,9,8,7,4,5]`.

Walk four shrinking boundaries — top, right, bottom, left — peeling one layer per loop.
hints: Maintain four bounds: top, bottom, left, right.
Each loop: go right across `top`, down `right`, left across `bottom`, up `left`, then shrink each bound inward.
Guard the bottom and left passes with `top <= bottom` / `left <= right` to avoid double-visiting in thin matrices.

solution.explanation: Each iteration traces the current outer ring and then contracts the boundaries, spiraling inward. The two guards before the bottom/left passes prevent re-reading a row or column when the remaining band is a single line. O(rows·cols).
